text:
alex: Hey team — AcmeCorp reporting lots of 5xx/504s hitting hosted inference starting ~08:12 UTC. P95 tail spiking to ~12s and then hitting timeouts. Can we triage?

mia: I see the spikes in grafana, request_queue_depth tops out at 1024 on a few hosts and continuous-batcher backlog grows.

sanjay: KV cache miss rate jumped at the same time (kvcache_miss_rate ~ 0.42). Batcher appears to stall when queue depth hits limit, we see dequeue stalls.

elaine: Customer support ticket C-2319 created, they pasted the SDK error: `504 Gateway Timeout` + `request aborted` after ~30s. They say it started after a small traffic ramp (~100->350 rps).

support: Escalated to SRE and oncall, customer impacted for two endpoints (text-generation, chat). Added temporary note to ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-03-17.3 to prod @08:05 UTC (canary passed). No rollbacks.

ops: Might be a combination: recent batching default window bumped from 8ms->20ms in release, + no extra headroom for high-concurrency tenants. That multiplies effective queue occupancy.

jamie: Quick mitigation I pushed: reduced continuous_batch_window to 6ms for hosted pool and bumped ingress max_dequeue_threads from 16->24 on affected AZ. Applied 08:26 UTC.

mia: After the change I see queue_depth drop and p95 back to ~1.2s on most hosts. Two hosts still show intermittent 5xx; digging into logs.

alex: Repro steps we've been using (share with SE):
```bash
# reproduce customer pattern
ab -n 1000 -c 120 -p longseq.json -T application/json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# longseq.json contains a ~2000-token prompt to hit KV warm path
```
run that for ~60s, you'll see dequeue stalls and then 504 spikes once depth approaches configured limit.

sanjay: Logs from one affected host: `ERROR batcher: dequeue_timeout after 12000ms, queue_depth=1018, active_batches=4` and `WARN gateway: upstream_closed_with_error 502`.

elaine: Customer confirmed reduction in errors after your config change. They still saw a blip at 08:30 but no sustained outage. Marking customer update in ticket.

ops: Root cause hypothesis: release increased batching window + tenant ramp -> sustained queue saturation. Continuous batcher backlog + kvcache churn prevented effective dequeueing, leading to timeouts and 5xx.

jamie: Next steps: 1) revert batching default in next patch OR make it tenant-aware, 2) add dynamic headroom scaling for high-concurrency tenants, 3) add alert for queue_depth > 900 sustained for >30s, 4) postmortem draft.

alex: I'll own the postmortem. Can someone add the signal queries and alerting PR? Suggest tagging as Sev-2 since customer saw impact.

support: Ticket updated to reflect mitigation and next steps, customer note sent.

ops: Will follow up with perf test to reproduce on staging with same settings. Posting links to traces and dashboards in thread. :mag:

sanjay: Saved key logs and grep pattern: `grep -E "dequeue_timeout|kvcache_miss_rate|queue_depth" /var/log/batcher/*.log` — putting them in the incident folder.

alex: Thanks all. If we see reappearance, revert batching window immediately and notify customers.

deploy-bot: incident-annotate: incident_id=INC-2026-0317-01, severity=2, owner=alex
